newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends flat as Dow drop weighs.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends flat as Dow drop weighs.

text.p: The UK's leading blue chip index finished little changed on Wednesday after an earlier Wall Street-inspired rally reversed and dragged UK shares off their best levels, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index closed 3.9 points higher at 4,762.4, as advancers narrowly beat decliners 52 to 47.
The Dow, which tested the 8,000 level initially, was down 40 points when London markets closed.
"We have a lot of domestic concerns, but at the moment, the market seems to be taking its lead from international factors," said stock strategist Corey Miller of Credit Lyonnais Laing.
